name: Keymed Biosciences Inc.
summary: Keymed Biosciences Inc., founded in 2016 in Chengdu and formerly 2Health Biosciences, Inc., researches and develops biologic treatments mainly for autoimmune and oncology diseases. Its lead candidate CM310 targets atopic dermatitis, asthma, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps and COPD, and CM326 is a monoclonal antibody for similar conditions. In oncology it is developing CMG901 for gastric tumors and CM313 for blood cancers, among other antibody candidates.
